title: Tim Cook marks final earnings call as Apple CEO, confirms Ternus will take over calls - 9to5Mac
summary: During today’s call discussing Apple’s Q3 2026 results, CEO Tim Cook took a moment to mark his final earnings call at the helm of the company, and to confirm that incoming CEO John Ternus will lead future calls.
